EVAL: exc-01
Extract the following fields from the document below and answer with ONLY a JSON object (no fences, no commentary) with keys: quote_id (string, as printed including OCR damage), prepared_for (string), total_usd (number, after the discount), discount_pct (number), valid (boolean — is the quote still valid per the document), line_items (array of item names in document order). Report numbers as bare JSON numbers with no currency symbols, commas, or units; report booleans as JSON true/false. Copy string values exactly as they appear in the document unless the key says otherwise. If a field is genuinely not stated, use the empty string "". Arrays must follow the order the key describes.

Document:
QU0TE #Q-2026-l88 (printed 07/30/2026)
Prepared for: Calloway Marine Services
Item: Impeller assembly — $2,200
Item: Gasket kit — $180
Subtotal $2,380 — loyalty discount 5% — TOTAL $2,261.00
This quote expired on August 30, 2026 and is no longer valid.

EVAL: exc-02
Extract the following fields from the document below and answer with ONLY a JSON object (no fences, no commentary) with keys: case_id (string), plaintiff (string), filing_year (number), amount_claimed_usd (number), jury_demanded (boolean), causes (array of the causes of action in the order pleaded). Report numbers as bare JSON numbers with no currency symbols, commas, or units; report booleans as JSON true/false. Copy string values exactly as they appear in the document unless the key says otherwise. If a field is genuinely not stated, use the empty string "". Arrays must follow the order the key describes.

Document:
CIVIL COVER SHEET — Case 26-CV-04412
Plaintiff: Ostrander Tool & Die LLC
Filed in 2026. Amount claimed: $86,500.
Causes of action as pleaded: (1) breach of contract; (2) unjust enrichment.
The plaintiff waives trial by jury.

EVAL: exc-03
Extract the following fields from the document below and answer with ONLY a JSON object (no fences, no commentary) with keys: reservation_code (string), guest (string), nights (number — compute from the dates), rate_per_night_usd (number), breakfast_included (boolean), room_type (string). Report numbers as bare JSON numbers with no currency symbols, commas, or units; report booleans as JSON true/false. Copy string values exactly as they appear in the document unless the key says otherwise. If a field is genuinely not stated, use the empty string "". Arrays must follow the order the key describes.

Document:
CONFIRMATION RES-XK42P
Guest: Amara Lindqvist
Check-in 12 Sept 2026, check-out 16 Sept 2026. Deluxe King room at $214 per night.
Rate is room-only; breakfast is available for a separate charge.

EVAL: exc-04
Extract the following fields from the document below and answer with ONLY a JSON object (no fences, no commentary) with keys: grant_id (string), institution (string), award_usd (number — the REVISED award), duration_months (number), renewable (boolean), pi (string, the principal investigator). Report numbers as bare JSON numbers with no currency symbols, commas, or units; report booleans as JSON true/false. Copy string values exactly as they appear in the document unless the key says otherwise. If a field is genuinely not stated, use the empty string "". Arrays must follow the order the key describes.

Document:
AWARD LETTER — Grant GR-2026-0057
Institution: Tidewater Research Collective
Original award $150,000 revised downward on appeal-of-budget to $132,000 (governing figure).
Duration: 18 months, non-renewable.
Principal investigator: Dr. Yusuf Adeyemi

EVAL: exc-05
Extract the following fields from the document below and answer with ONLY a JSON object (no fences, no commentary) with keys: work_order (string), technician (string), parts_total_usd (number — sum the parts lines), labor_hours (number), warranty_claim (boolean), equipment (string). Report numbers as bare JSON numbers with no currency symbols, commas, or units; report booleans as JSON true/false. Copy string values exactly as they appear in the document unless the key says otherwise. If a field is genuinely not stated, use the empty string "". Arrays must follow the order the key describes.

Document:
WORK ORDER WO-5570 — Equipment: Vestergaard chiller unit 3
Technician: Priya Natarajan-Cole
Parts: compressor contactor $96.50; refrigerant charge $210.00; drier core $43.50
Labor: 3.5 hours
Billing: customer pay — this repair is not covered under warranty.

EVAL: exc-06
Extract the following fields from the document below and answer with ONLY a JSON object (no fences, no commentary) with keys: policy_number (string), insured (string), premium_usd (number — the ANNUAL premium; the document quotes monthly), deductible_usd (number), flood_covered (boolean), effective_date (string, as written). Report numbers as bare JSON numbers with no currency symbols, commas, or units; report booleans as JSON true/false. Copy string values exactly as they appear in the document unless the key says otherwise. If a field is genuinely not stated, use the empty string "". Arrays must follow the order the key describes.

Document:
DECLARATIONS — Policy HO-88-31245
Named insured: Theodore Mbeki-Aldana
Premium: $187.50 per month (billed monthly)
Deductible: $2,500
Effective date: October 1, 2026
Flood: excluded under this policy; a separate flood policy was declined.

EVAL: exc-07
Extract the following fields from the document below and answer with ONLY a JSON object (no fences, no commentary) with keys: shipment_ref (string — only the row flagged HOLD), destination (string), cartons (number), customs_cleared (boolean), incoterm (string), description (string). Report numbers as bare JSON numbers with no currency symbols, commas, or units; report booleans as JSON true/false. Copy string values exactly as they appear in the document unless the key says otherwise. If a field is genuinely not stated, use the empty string "". Arrays must follow the order the key describes.

Document:
PORT LOG (merged rows):
SH-2201 Rotterdam 40ctn cleared:yes DAP "Machine spares" RELEASED | SH-2202 Antwerp 12ctn cleared:no EXW "Lab reagents" HOLD | SH-2203 Hamburg 55ctn cleared:yes FOB "Textiles" RELEASED

EVAL: exc-08
Extract the following fields from the document below and answer with ONLY a JSON object (no fences, no commentary) with keys: ticket_id (string), reporter (string), severity (string — the severity AFTER re-triage), affected_users (number), resolved (boolean), component (string). Report numbers as bare JSON numbers with no currency symbols, commas, or units; report booleans as JSON true/false. Copy string values exactly as they appear in the document unless the key says otherwise. If a field is genuinely not stated, use the empty string "". Arrays must follow the order the key describes.

Document:
INCIDENT TICKET T-99148 — component: export-scheduler
Reporter: Ingrid Vasquez-Toll
Opened at SEV-2; re-triaged to SEV-1 at 14:20 after impact review (governing severity).
Impact: approximately 3,400 users affected.
Status: mitigation in place; the incident remains unresolved pending root cause.
